title: Grade 4 Math — Thu, May 28
description: Perimeter & Area — Day 4 of 5: Area of irregular shapes & composite figures
subject: mathematics

questions.question: How do you find area of an irregular (L-shaped) figure?
options: Split into rectangles, find each area, add them
Measure the perimeter and square it
questions.explanation: Composite/irregular shapes: split into simple rectangles → find each area → add all areas together.

questions.question: T-shape made of two rectangles: A (6×2 cm) and B (2×4 cm). Total area?
questions.explanation: A = 6×2 = 12 cm². B = 2×4 = 8 cm². Total = 12+8 = 20 cm².

questions.question: A large rectangle 10×8 cm has a 3×4 cm hole cut out. Remaining area?
questions.explanation: Large area = 10×8 = 80 cm². Hole = 3×4 = 12 cm². Remaining = 80−12 = 68 cm².

questions.question: Estimate: shape on grid has about 14 full squares and 6 half squares. Approximate area?
questions.explanation: Full squares: 14. Half squares: 6 × ½ = 3. Total ≈ 14+3 = 17 cm².

questions.question: Staircase shape: three steps, each step is 2 cm wide and 1 cm tall. Each step is one rectangle 2×1. Total area of 3 steps?
questions.explanation: Each step area = 2×1 = 2 cm². Three steps = 3×2 = 6 cm².

questions.question: A path 1 m wide goes around a 8 m × 5 m garden. What is the area of the path only?
questions.explanation: Outer rectangle = (8+2)×(5+2) = 10×7 = 70 m². Inner = 8×5 = 40 m². Path = 70−40 = 30 m².

questions.question: Which gives more floor space: one 12×8 m room OR two 6×8 m rooms?
questions.explanation: One: 12×8=96 m². Two: 2×(6×8)=96 m². Same total area!

questions.question: A cross (+) shape: vertical bar 1×6 and horizontal bar 6×1, overlapping in a 1×1 square. Total area?
questions.explanation: Vertical: 1×6=6. Horizontal: 6×1=6. Overlap: 1×1=1. Area = 6+6−1 = 11 cm². Don't double-count overlap.

questions.question: Floor plan: living room 5×4 m + kitchen 3×3 m + bedroom 4×3 m. Total floor area?
A square of side 6 cm has a square of side 2 cm in each corner removed (4 corners). Remaining area?
questions.explanation: Large square = 6×6=36 cm². 4 small squares = 4×(2×2) = 4×4 = 16 cm². Remaining = 36−16 = 20 cm².

questions.question: Swimming pool 20×10 m surrounded by tiles 2 m wide. Area of tiles?
Tiles of area 4 cm² each cover a floor of 200 cm². How many tiles?
An irregular field has these parts: 20×15 m + 10×8 m. Total area?
A rectangular table 150 cm × 90 cm. Tablecloth hangs 15 cm on each side. What size tablecloth?
questions.explanation: Length = 150 + 2×15 = 180 cm. Width = 90 + 2×15 = 120 cm. Area of cloth = 180×120.
